title: Smoky Venezuelan Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic side dish inspired by Venezuelan cuisine, made with smoky rice pilaf.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add rice pilaf and stir to coat with oil and mix with onion and garlic.
Add chicken broth, tomato paste, and dried cilantro; bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18-20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Fluff rice pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
